title: Influence of CO2 substitution for N2 on the combustion characteristics and kinetics of oil shale under oxy-fuel conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37937-37950
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05471K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qi Liu, Qing Wang, Zhichao Wang, Huishuang Di
Leveraging coupled TGA-DSC-MS, we tracked characteristic changes in the oil shale combustion process by integrating mass-loss profiles, heat-flow signals, and gaseous product data, thereby enabling more robust and comprehensive conclusions.
